findings.message: While broker request A is pending, hydrate this same lease as missing and call ensurePlayback: the new authority-refusal request replaces playbackRequests. Hydrate it as available and let request B complete successfully. A later rejection from A passes only mediaEpoch/sourceId checks at lines321-322 and clears B’s valid URL, publishing unavailable/gen4 after valid/gen3; a late success at lines295-305 instead replaces B with A’s older URL. Both were reproduced against the exact submitted source. Fence success and catch publication with captured per-request ownership in addition to current media/source/authority checks, registering ownership before synchronous authority/quota errors can publish; keep finally cleanup ownership and all existing quota/policy/generation behavior. Add meaningful same-source old-success and old-failure race regressions proving the newer request remains authoritative. Raw script/output: .git/gusta/v1/launchers/si8/T780/review-race-repro-e0ba99e4.mjs and .json.
